function: Deep-unfolded Bayesian learning (DUBL) estimates the wideband hybrid-field THz uplink channel; a CNN with attention learns the covariance update of each unrolled EM layer; pp. 7-11.
system: Uplink OFDM THz UM-MIMO, array-of-subarrays BS, 4 subarrays x 36 elements (144 antennas), 4 RF chains, single-antenna user, 300 GHz, 30 GHz bandwidth, 16 subcarriers; no RIS; pp. 4, 13.
method: Deep unfolding of EM-based Bayesian learning into 4 layers with CNN, learnable padding and dual attention; supervised staged offline training (extraction, attention, joint fine-tuning), NMSE loss; pp. 8-12.
data_channel: Own hybrid-field THz simulator (near/far-field wavefronts, HITRAN absorption, reflections, 5 paths); 3200 training, 320 validation, 320 test samples; no standard model or measurement; pp. 4-5, 13.
test_conditions: Same simulator for training and testing; tSNR drawn from 110-160 dB for all splits; tested over tSNR and pilot length; no unseen channel configuration or adaptation; pp. 13-15.
baselines: Non-learned: LS, OMP, SOMP, subcarrier-wise BL, MMV-BL. Learned: FPN-OAMP [7] (deep-unfolded OAMP); variants DUBL without attention and DUBL Dedicated; pp. 13-14.
metrics: NMSE versus number of pilots (36-144) and versus tSNR (110-160 dB); validation loss versus epoch; NMSE versus unfolding depth; FLOPs-based complexity; pp. 13-16.
complexity: Per-layer order O(K(S^3+P N_RF S^2)+SKc^2Nf^2+MWDA terms), and orders of LS, OMP, SOMP, BL variants and FPN-OAMP compared in Table III; no runtime measured; pp. 12, 16.
q1_support: p. 4: "this work delivers the wideband hybrid-field channel model" - own THz simulator (Eqs. 1-21, parameters p. 13); no 3GPP model, public ray-tracing dataset or measurement; TeraMIMO [36] is cited only for the single-bounce assumption.
q2_support: p. 13: "tSNRs are randomly picked from the set of" {110:10:160} dB for the data samples, so the Fig. 12 tSNR sweep lies inside the training set; no unseen configuration, pilot length, array or adaptation is reported.
q3_support: p. 14: "8) FPN-OAMP: [7] It refers to the fixed point network" - earlier learned deep-unfolded estimator; non-learned LS, OMP, SOMP, SW-BL and MMV-BL are also compared, all on NMSE (Fig. 11).
q4_support: p. 12: "the time complexity of the proposed DUBL solution per layer is on the scale of" O(K(S^3+P N_RF S^2)+SKc^2Nf^2+attention terms), with FLOPs as the metric; Table III (p. 16) compares orders.
q5_support: p. 13: "we generate 3200, 320 and 320 samples" - own simulated data; no code or data link is given, and HITRAN [47] only supplies molecular absorption constants.
notes: Included as area 2 (channel estimation); deep unfolding with trained parameters counts as learned. q2 is 0: the paper claims generalization to distribution shifts (pp. 3, 12), but the only variation tested is the tSNR sweep, whose levels are in the training set; whether a model is retrained per pilot length is not stated. q3 is 1 because FPN-OAMP [7] is an earlier published learned estimator, while DUBL w.o. MWDA and DUBL Dedicated are variants and were not counted. Tables II and III and Figs. 10-12 were read as page images.
